title: Vibes from before cores: unanchored, one empty, two overlapping, unfiled films with and without a verdict
construction_note: S5 / D12. No Vibe here has a core, and a v13 build cannot write one without, so this fixture is never seeded through today's tools. It is seeded through the tools of a v12 build (tonight main 15a6095) and the database is then migrated to v13 — never by direct SQL. See README, 'The legacy fixture'. Machete anchors Grindhouse Mayhem plausibly; Polite Suspicion holds no film; Bad Date, Worse Alibi and Holiday Alibis describe one evening; Logan Lucky is unfiled with a reason that may justify one new-Vibe offer; Wingwomen is unfiled with no verdict and must never be raised.
